title: My first game cost less than a pizza night.
author: Any_Inevitable_4035
selftext:
Hey all,

I’d never made a game before. I kept meaning to try and kept not doing it. Eventually I just started describing what I wanted inside Unity and let the agent write and wire up the scripts.

This is what came out: **Shizu no Kage (静の影)**  
[https://xorin.ai/made-with-xorin/shizu-no-kage](https://xorin.ai/made-with-xorin/shizu-no-kage)

It’s a small stealth game. You play Akari, who sneaks into a lord’s palace at night to find her little brother. She can’t fight, so you hide in shadows, slip past guards, and snuff out lanterns.

I work at Xorin, and that’s the tool I used to build this. So yes, this is self promo. I’m still curious what you actually think of the game.

Rough numbers: 43 prompts, about 2.5 hours of agent time, and $43.58 in credits. Xorin handled the gameplay side (guards, noise, lighting, HUD, levels). The art and audio came from artists and other tools.

The full Unity project is on that page if you want to dig into it or fix my mess.

I’d love honest feedback, especially on pacing, how the stealth feels, and the controls. Don’t go easy on me.

comments.author: Any_Inevitable_4035
comments.body:
Thanks, glad it holds up for a first try!

On the art and audio: Xorin only handled the gameplay code. The voices were made with other AI tools.

And yeah, you’re right about the guard flashlights. The detection cone doesn’t quite line up with the light, so you can get spotted when it looks like you’re outside the beam. That’s going on the fix list. Was it mostly at close range or from farther away?

replies.author: maxneuds
replies.body:
For me it was more weird, that I could be clearly in the cone and still not count as detected. The guard seemed to be agitated but didn't do much. Getting detected without being in the cone was mostly close to the cone, straight line.

Which AI did you use for the voice? I really like it.

comments.author: Any_Inevitable_4035
comments.body: Lol, It's fine. I will improve it slowly

comments.author: Any_Inevitable_4035
comments.body: Thanks for commenting, this is my first game and i have no coding and game dev experience background. I am using Xorin to learn game dev and yes it can manage coding part for me

comments.author: Any_Inevitable_4035
comments.body: thanks, I don't have any exp in game dev so i used Xorin Ai to learn from scratch and i am still learning

replies.author: Think_Golf_4411
replies.body: What did you actually learn though? The AI did the work for you.  Im also new to game development, like less than 6 months new.  I used AI to find bugs when I couldn't then figured it out from there. Im not saying AI has no place in game dev, but you definitely arent learning if you did nothing.
